description: Five Millennium Catalogs of Solar and Lunar Eclipses (Espenak and Meeus, NASA GSFC), 1901-2100. td_greatest is the instant of greatest eclipse in Terrestrial Dynamical Time (= TT), rounded to the second; values are copied as printed. The type keeps NASA's suffix, e.g. 'T-' (non-central total).

acknowledgment.solar: Eclipse Predictions by Fred Espenak (NASA's GSFC)
acknowledgment.lunar: Eclipse Predictions by Fred Espenak and Jean Meeus (NASA's GSFC)
